candidate_claim_cn: 智能体能迁移构造辨别实验的能力，即使接收者所在世界的规律已经改变。
claim_status: Unproven: the generated policy benefit remains matched by same-prior GP; both new noiseless neuron instances are solved by conventional same-data fitting. No distinct experiment-learning operation is established.

carrier.learner_inputs: Only current segments, observed voltage and observation indices; no world identity, hidden mechanism parameters or test targets before model freeze.

result.scope: Interface preparation only: researcher-supplied requests, no learned experiment compiler, transfer advantage, or discovery task score.
result.prior_attempt: v0 failed at package import (missing requests); no native experiment ran.

result.decision: Do not accept frozen scalar nulling or unrestricted scalar recalibration as the new method. Source nulling need not transport; recalibration here is identical to ordinary target-only fitting in the supplied family.
result.limitation: Two deterministic native fixtures and researcher-supplied paired power-law family only; no autonomous law discovery, new action-interface compiler, strong general discovery-agent comparison, or official task score.

operation.implemented_shared_component: Full-voltage fixed-family mechanistic forecaster; conventional comparator, not proposed method.
operation.supported_previous: Source-generated action prior, matched by ordinary GP with that prior.

closest_priors.difference_required: Already jointly learns structural edits and diagnostic experiments, including shared-parameter class discrimination, observation-map changes, and transfer. Generic joint proposal or null testing is insufficient as the contribution.

Already maintains competing SCMs, designs discriminating interventions, revises models from discrepancies, and transfers evolved SCMs across model backbones. Merely using executable scientific beliefs is insufficient.

decision: Retain the working full-trace comparator; stop expanding these already solved instances. Require an executable distinct learning update and acquisition advantage before scale-up.
next_requirement: Do not scale the two solved noiseless development instances or attribute the old count-only failure to missing experiments. Specify and implement a distinct experiment-learning update with source and target roles, then test whether it lowers total acquisition cost with this same full-trace forecaster and equal native control access. A fixed conditioning template, choosing a supplied model family, unspecified inverse program solver, or generic model-metamer construction is not an established new contribution. Keep MDA-style joint model/experiment design and same-prior continuous design as relevant comparators. Novelty and multiple core-task evidence remain required before GPU scale-up.
headline_cn: 同样的已有观测交给完整轨迹机制拟合器，两个任务的原生预测 MSE 均为 0；此前的失败未证明需要新实验。
report_note_cn: 已实现共享的完整电压轨迹预测器：从公开基础动力学与通用额外电流参数化出发，按训练轨迹选择模型，再自由运行预测。只复用上一轮两个机制各 3 次观测，原生六协议计数预测 MSE 从计数 LLM 的 60.75／200.75 降为 0／0；原生特征预测 MSE 分别约 1.61e-28／2.32e-30。钠疲劳选择了公开提供的慢钠动力学，钙反跳由通用单通道参数拟合得到。这是固定模型族内的常规系统辨识，未发现新的实验构造操作，也未复现完整 MDA。两个任务均为无噪声开发实例，部分评分协议与采集菜单重叠；结果不能外推到全部机制、噪声条件或严格未见协议。加速模拟器与原生实现的 8 次公开模型比较通过，最大电压差约 1.51e-11 mV。本轮新增真实采集 0 次、API 调用 0 次，训练用模型模拟 19431 次，预测模拟 12 次，双方一致性模拟各 8 次，隐藏评分轨迹 12 次；未使用 GPU。停止扩展这两个已被基线解决的设置，把预测器保留为后续相同推理能力的比较组件。

assessment.proposal: Learn and transfer a typed excitation certificate: paired perturbations, response norm/rank criteria, and a repair decision tree.
assessment.nearest_standard_operation: Sequential E-optimal / persistent-excitation experiment design; the response itself does not claim a distinction at equal information and computation.
assessment.assessment: No new experiment-construction operation was specified beyond a source-learned intervention script or decision policy. A nonzero control response and full rank with respect to controls do not certify identification of a requested mechanism against unknown nuisance parameters. Do not score the proposal as novel or count it as experimental support.

numerical_boundary.consequence: Every indicated contrast is nonzero, yet theta cannot be identified separately from eta at any u. This is an analytic illustration, not an additional native experiment.

assessment.scope: This rejects the proposed identification certificate, not all learned experimental policies or causal effect detection.

result.scope: One upstream native no-mid-round-fit episode; final parameters fit only to its own four experiment trajectories; three public evaluator fixtures; no full benchmark or method comparison.

native_discovery_pilot.protocol_note: Native DiscoveryAgent with public no-mid-round-fit option, max_rounds=4 and min_rounds=2; submitted at round3, then native explanation-format follow-up. Native final parameter fitting retained. No critic or explanation judge. Model alias backend not independently verified.

result.researcher_supplied_baseline: Extend the submitted central inverse-square model to an arbitrary radial power, using native parameter fitting on exactly the same four acquired trajectories. This is an ordinary target-only model baseline, not our method.
result.scope: Same-data identification check on three public evaluator fixtures. No source experience or new experiment construction.

previous_native_discovery_headline_cn: 原生发现基线的轨迹误差为1.85，但同数据普通可变指数拟合降至0.00272并通过三个默认轨迹测试；该失败不能作为实验迁移优势的证据。
previous_native_discovery_report_note_cn: 完成一次 DiscoverPhysics extra_dimensions 原生发现流程：glm-5.3 共4次调用，实际执行4次自选实验，并提交规律。使用原生期末参数拟合后，该规律在三个公开默认测试中的平均粒子位置平方误差为1.84868，未通过0.01阈值。研究者仅给其逆平方模型增加可拟合径向指数，复用完全相同的4条训练轨迹和3条测试真值，误差降至0.002724并通过轨迹阈值；未增加实验或API调用。这是普通目标端拟合基线，不是我们的方法，也不等于发现了完整额外维度机制：未评解释指标。另一次 deepseek-v4-pro 评议返回的激励证书方案仍未给出区别于已有激励设计的算法，未采纳。当前结果说明，不能把单一LLM的错误归因于缺少新实验。未使用GPU，不扩大该固定测试。

result.candidate: Transfer the ability to construct identifying experiments across changed worlds.
result.claim_status: Unproven; general experimental preparation is already an existing planning capability.
result.environment: Native SymbolicAlchemy; one stone and four consumable potions per trial; four trials per episode.
result.researcher_supplied: Known identity perceptual maps; native random-bottleneck graph prior. No source-trained constructor or hidden true graph supplied to policies.
baselines: Upstream within-trial exhaustive ideal explorer with native belief updates
result.decision: Retain the native exact within-trial planner as a required baseline. Retire generic preparation as the claimed novelty. Do not scale this fixed known-map, one-stone, four-potion family absent a distinct source-dependent operation and a measured benefit.
result.next_requirement: Specify a concrete learned transformation of source experience that changes recipient experiment construction, then compare with equal-information target-only planning, ordinary policy/skill transfer and learned/amortized experimental design. DEL-style prerequisite learning and renamed macro-actions do not suffice. The present runs do not falsify all cross-world experimental transfer.
limitations: Selected diagnostic checkpoints, not independent held-out tasks.
Known perceptual mappings simplify the full Alchemy benchmark.
The native explorer optimizes expected remaining world count within the current trial, not total multi-trial reward.
Planning timings isolate upstream search, so they are not end-to-end inference costs or a fair cost comparison to a learned method.
No novel constructor or source-transfer arm was evaluated.

setup.compatibility: dm-env-rpc pinned to 1.1.6 and numpy to 1.23.5; upstream planner and transitions unchanged. Initial wrapper v0 failed before the first native step; v1 corrected its optional argument forwarding.

closest_priors.title: Alchemy ideal observer
closest_priors.finding: Native search explicitly recurses through deterministic state-changing actions before later information gains and offers an objective minimizing remaining world states.

closest_priors.title: Learning Game Strategies by Experimentation
closest_priors.finding: DEL learns prerequisites and contextual conditions for experiments, postpones ambiguous tests, and lifts traces into reusable strategic plans. This is a direct prior against generic experiment-preparation novelty.

result.headline_cn: Alchemy原生规划器已能构造零即时信息的准备动作；三个相同历史对照中，候选规律数由12／12／8降至6／8／1，单步策略均停留原处。该能力尚不能作为新贡献。
result.report_note_cn: 完成Alchemy原生符号环境的8种子、每种子两种策略、每次4试次对照，共194个原生动作。已知感知映射，未知瓶颈图，使用原生图先验与信念更新。原生ideal explorer对当前试次完整搜索，跨试次只保留后验，不是整个四试次episode的全局最优规划。记录到6次零即时信息收益的准备动作，其中3次的全部可选动作均无单步信息收益。对这3个探索后选出的状态重放相同历史：单步策略保留12／12／8个候选，原生规划分别降至6／8／1；重放及分支另用70个动作，其中52个重放、18个继续执行。它们不是3个独立留出任务。已有搜索在每个四试次episode累计约3.6–24.6毫秒，未包含预计算加载与诊断开销。当前没有训练或评估迁移方法，也没有证明源经验优势。停止把一般实验准备或未测量的计算节省作为新意；不扩大该小型对照。

ambiguity_cover_construction_review.analytic_result: The specified post-history separation sets are necessarily empty; using pre-history sets repairs the definition but leaves ordinary target-side test cover with a transferred prior. No distinct benefit established.

previous_preparation_report_note_cn: 完成Alchemy原生符号环境的8种子、每种子两种策略、每次4试次对照，共194个原生动作。已知感知映射，未知瓶颈图，使用原生图先验与信念更新。原生ideal explorer对当前试次完整搜索，跨试次只保留后验，不是整个四试次episode的全局最优规划。记录到6次零即时信息收益的准备动作，其中3次的全部可选动作均无单步信息收益。对这3个探索后选出的状态重放相同历史：单步策略保留12／12／8个候选，原生规划分别降至6／8／1；重放及分支另用70个动作，其中52个重放、18个继续执行。它们不是3个独立留出任务。已有搜索在每个四试次episode累计约3.6–24.6毫秒，未包含预计算加载与诊断开销。当前没有训练或评估迁移方法，也没有证明源经验优势。停止把一般实验准备或未测量的计算节省作为新意；不扩大该小型对照。 本轮进一步构造的“歧义覆盖模式迁移”方案未采纳：按其更新定义，历史中已执行实验的分离集合必为空；改用实验前集合可修正定义，但仍未给出超越普通目标端实验覆盖选择的操作。该项是算法分析，不是新增原生任务证据。

result.candidate_claim: Source experience can become a generator of informative recipient experiments without transferring numerical predictions.
result.claim_status: Unproven as a novel method or broad advantage; this prototype implements ordinary relation composition.

result.interpretation: Source traces generate unseen contrasts that can expose a changed contextual dependence. In this construction the generator is ordinary relation composition and every source equality is also predicted by a same-data tabular model. Native witnesses demonstrate capability, not novelty or an advantage over those strong comparators.
result.limitations: One selected source-target pair, known identity perceptual mappings, researcher-controlled resets, exhaustive source-state coverage, no full discovery or reward task, and unequal costs between primitive and composed probes. Do not report a transfer success rate or sample-efficiency gain.

operation.source_learning: Group ordered two-action words by their observed endpoints over all eight source states, retaining empirically commuting action pairs.
operation.generation: For a source noncommuting block ab and an action c commuting with both a and b, emit cab versus abc.
operation.standard_operation: Two applications of ordinary adjacent commutation rewrite rules. No new inference or synthesis operator is established.
operation.same_data_baseline: Build a 48-entry exact transition table from the same source traces. Rolling out the generated words verifies all of their source endpoint equalities. This is an equality-prediction comparator, not a reproduced autonomous target discovery agent.

researcher_supplied.source_states: All eight controlled source initial states.
researcher_supplied.mappings: Known identity perceptual maps; no cross-interface alignment learned.
researcher_supplied.grammar: Hand-specified cab/abc composition template and a noncommuting ab filter; only the relation basis is inferred from observations.

result.decision: Do not scale this fixed relation-composition template or call it a novel compiler. Preserve the working source-artifact and native-execution harness. Neither a native witness nor a more elaborate name supplies a distinct learning operation.
result.next_requirement: A further candidate must change the construction operation beyond standard relation closure or a supplied metamorphic-test template, and demonstrate an advantage over same-source learned forward models and existing experiment-generation methods. Feedback-dependent experiment programs are a possible next direction, but fixed flow-composition or time-reversal templates alone are classical operations and are not accepted contributions.

continuous_interface_inspection.finding: The native oscillator uses time-modulated coupling G(t)=G0*cos(omega*t+phi), while several two-particle worlds are autonomous. Restart/continuation or velocity-reversal feedback programs could probe this distinction, but would require careful control of the experiment clock and available state.
continuous_interface_inspection.status: Candidate-interface inspection only; no feedback-program learner implemented or tested, no novelty claim.

closest_priors.title: On the Sensory Commutativity of Action Sequences for Embodied Agents
closest_priors.finding: Studies sensory commutation of action sequences, defines SCP, and demonstrates environment learning and reinforcement-learning sample-efficiency uses. Commutation itself is not new.

closest_priors.title: QTRAN: Extending Metamorphic-Oracle Based Logical Bug Detection Techniques for Multiple-DBMS Dialect Support
closest_priors.finding: Official code describes transfer and mutation of paired metamorphic tests across DBMS dialects. Generic cross-system transfer of relational tests is already studied. This turn inspected the official repository, not a reproduction.

closest_priors.title: Towards Automated Metamorphic Test Identification for Ocean System Models
closest_priors.finding: Proposes learning physical-model metamorphic relations with a cost penalizing trivial identity and redundancy. Primary abstract inspected; no reproduction. Automated relation learning alone cannot be the claimed novelty.

result.headline_cn: 源经验生成了未见过的三步对照，并暴露两步测试遗漏的条件依赖；但生成操作属于普通关系复合，尚未建立新方法优势。
result.report_note_cn: 完成一个原生Alchemy实验生成原型：在bottleneck2源世界的8个初态上执行全部不同动作的两步序列，实际480个动作，完全由观测学习到8条交换关系。仅使用这些关系，构造32组三步对照；生成集合在目标调用前冻结。在预先选定的bottleneck1目标初态中，8组两步对照均未发现差异，32组三步对照中1组出现不同结果。新增三步程序在源世界的32组原生验证均保持相等。总计896个原生动作：源采集480、源组合验证192、目标两步32、目标三步192。该结果展示了可执行的源经验实验生成，但还不是新方法证据：普通相邻交换规则的闭包可以重现全部32个对照，同数据学到的48项精确源转移表也预测其全部源等式。两个目标检测方案使用的动作数不同，不能声称样本效率提高；只是一组研究者选定的源／目标机制例子，不是独立留出任务成功率。未使用API或GPU。

previous_relation_compiler_headline_cn: 源经验生成了未见过的三步对照，并暴露两步测试遗漏的条件依赖；但生成操作属于普通关系复合，尚未建立新方法优势。

previous_construction_headline_cn: 同数据的普通转移比较已解释 Alchemy 条件依赖；更快找到区分实验也不直接意味着更少实验，尚未建立新方法优势。
previous_construction_report_note_cn: 复核上一轮 Alchemy 原生轨迹后，同一 x+ 动作在仅 z 不同的两个状态下效果不同；普通匹配转移比较即可提取这一条件依赖，无需新增实验，因此不能把该例当作新实验构造方法的独有能力。另完成可复现的有限候选集分析：在 8 个均匀候选中，两种策略每次都找到一步区分实验，但先找到即执行平均需要 4.375 次查询，均衡划分需要 3 次；在 32 个候选中分别为 16.46875 和 5 次。这是解析构造，不能计为原生任务结果，也没有训练或否定一个已实现的证明策略。备用模型提出的证明搜索方案仍缺少具体规则与跨任务优势，未采纳为新方法。本轮 3 次研究 API 请求，2 次超时、1 次成功；没有新增原生交互或 GPU 工作。
previous_feedback_headline_cn: 原生反馈程序学习与迁移已跑通，但完整状态与时钟的固定基线同样全部通过，且省去学习成本；尚无新方法优势。
previous_feedback_report_note_cn: 完成一个原生 DiscoverPhysics 反馈程序原型：在预先给定的续接模板与 32 种字段绑定中，用 gravity 的 66 次实际调用保留 2 个源数据无法区分的程序；二者都传递中间位置和速度，区别是是否推进绝对时钟。迁移到 yukawa、coulomb_easy、extra_dimensions、oscillator，每个目标用 1 个校准条件、3 次调用选择变体，再检查 3 个预先固定的后续条件。冻结的省略时钟变体在前三类各通过 3/3，在 oscillator 为 0/3；保留歧义后校准的程序四类均通过 3/3。然而完整传递状态和时钟的固定基线也四类全部通过，并且不需要源学习或目标校准，因此不能声称新的方法收益。全部 126 次原生调用在 CPU 上耗时约 22.2 秒，无模型 API 或 GPU。这里测量的是续接一致性，不是规律发现成功率；模板和字段语法由研究者提供。原生 oscillator 已提供 start_time，不能把遗漏时钟后的差异说成隐藏状态或耗散机制。

result.scope: Within-level unseen-seed development screen; not cross-level transfer or a new-method claim.

previous_program_catalog_headline_cn: 公开实验经验带来了可用源样本，但程序与普通预测模型、固定经验序列同为 1/8；尚未学出新程序结构或取得方法优势。
previous_program_catalog_report_note_cn: 新增 Interphyre 原生 CPU 筛查：catapult 与 pass_the_parcel 各 8 个源种子、48 个共有动作表达式，共 768 次源放置查询，没有成功样本。程序搜索返回固定序列 [0,1,2]，没有学出条件分支。各 8 个独立目标种子上，程序、同数据核预测模型、源贪心序列与 Halton 序列均为 0/16；这说明本次采集未满足有效比较的条件，不能据此否定一般的实验程序学习。另做 12 次原生控制：官方已知解 4/4 成功；HExA 论文中的两个字面放置动作共执行 8 次，其中一个动作解决 3/4 个源种子。控制结果不进入训练，也不算 HExA 复现。合计 972 次放置查询，575 次有效物理轨迹，无模型 API 或 GPU；固定候选库不扩量。 随后从 HExA 公开的 5 条源轨迹中提取 45 个尝试过的放置动作，向全部比较方法提供相同候选。新增 360 次源调用，在 3/8 个源种子上各得到 1 个成功动作；3 步固定序列已覆盖这些源成功，程序搜索仍没有产生分支。新的 catapult 目标种子 200–207 上，程序、同数据预测模型、固定源序列均成功 1/8，分别使用 24、23、24 次放置查询；按库顺序取前三个动作成功 0/8。后续共 455 次查询，其中 274 次有效物理轨迹。两次筛查加控制合计 1427 次查询、849 次有效轨迹；未调用模型 API 或 GPU。前后目标集合不同，不能把 0/16 与 1/8 当作经验库改进的因果对照。所有结果仍未支持新方法，固定候选排序路线不再扩量。

result.scope: Small native development comparison, not a new method or faithful Causal-PIK/HExA reproduction.

previous_continuous_headline_cn: 连续搜索基线在原生核心任务上已跑通；当前事件割线候选与普通回归等价，仍未建立新方法。
previous_continuous_report_note_cn: 新增连续动作搜索比较：catapult 与 pass_the_parcel 各 4 个固定开发种子，每种方法每任务最多 25 次放置，包含相同的 5 次初始尝试。采用每次新建环境的独立尝试后，CMA-ES 与 RBF 贝叶斯优化均成功 2/8，随机物体先验为 0/8；分别消耗 186、179、200 次查询。最终比较共 565 次查询、432 条有效物理轨迹，CPU 约 8.8 秒；这只是小规模开发基线，不是新方法优势或 HExA/Causal-PIK 复现。4 个成功动作与每类 1 个失败动作通过原生 env.step 重放，结果与步数一致。初版复用环境的结果保留但由独立重置版取代。另核验事件割线候选：在固定事件分组和完整等权样本对条件下，其线性学习规则与中心化岭回归严格等价；49 组原生数据上系数差低于 8e-14、动作建议差低于 1.8e-13。该候选不作为新机制扩量；非线性程序生成并未因此被否定。本轮主、备用 glm-5.3 评议均超时，已分别提醒，备用 deepseek-v4-pro 随后成功；模型意见经过独立代数与代码核验，没有被直接当作研究证据。未使用 GPU。

previous_continuous_operation.source_artifact: q_s = log(abs(a_s(2)/a_s(1)))/log(2), learned from two source responses.
previous_continuous_operation.target_update: Replace q_s by q_t estimated using the same formula on two recipient responses.
previous_continuous_operation.baseline_equivalence: Unrestricted replacement removes all dependence on q_s. This is exactly target-only fitting of a(m)=c*m**q in the supplied family, at the same target query count.
previous_continuous_operation.interpretation_boundary: A nonzero frozen contrast can correctly falsify the source relation. It is a failure only if that relation is assumed to remove a shared nuisance. This screen does not falsify all experiment transfer or all source-derived null tests.

previous_continuous_latest_turn_usage.source_program_induction: 32 candidates filtered to 2 by 2 source reference cases and 64 source restart calls

result.scope: Development test of executable policy generation, not a claim that program generation itself is novel, nor an ICLR-scale evaluation.

feedback_ablation.scope: Post hoc causal diagnosis on the same eight development targets, not independent confirmation.

prior_matched_optimizers.scope: Post hoc mechanism diagnosis on the same eight development tasks, not independent confirmation or a HExA/Causal-PIK reproduction.

previous_policy_generation_headline_cn: 源经验生成的策略在 8 个新几何任务上全通过；同一动作先验加普通 GP 也为 8/8，尚未建立独特的新机制。
previous_policy_generation_report_note_c: 本轮首次实际生成并执行实验策略：deepseek-v4-pro 分别读取 8 个源场景的 106 条精选观测或仅任务说明，各生成一个未修改的程序。源记录共 565 次已完成查询，未新增采集。两类任务各 4 个此前未用于生成的种子，每任务最多 25 次尝试。有经验程序成功 8/8、共 37 次尝试，无经验程序 0/8、200 次；读取全部源数据的几何条件 GP 为 3/8、171 次，目标任务 GP 为 2/8、196 次。成功动作均通过原生 env.step 重放，结果和步数一致。同一批任务上的事后消融显示：屏蔽接触事件标签仍为 8/8、37 次且轨迹完全一致；完全无历史为 7/8、59 次；保留尝试次数但屏蔽结果反馈为 6/8、70 次。将同一个源程序的无历史动作先验交给普通优化器后，GP 也达到 8/8、45 次，CMA-ES 为 6/8、71 次。因此收益主要支持源经验构造了有效的几何动作先验，尚不能归因于新的实验反馈机制；37 对 45 次的差异仍是单一策略、单一随机种子的开发结果。这里只改变场景几何，没有测试物理规律改变、跨任务族迁移，也没有复现完整 HExA/Causal-PIK。本轮合计 894 次查询、746 条有效轨迹（含 8 次验证重放）、3 次成功模型请求，未使用 GPU。备用配置复核和两次程序生成均成功，主接口本轮未重测。

previous_policy_generation_operation.source: Model-authored executable action policy from a frozen source-only observation packet.
previous_policy_generation_operation.target: Public scene plus own trial history produce continuous placements; unchanged code.
previous_policy_generation_operation.observed_contribution: Geometry-relative source-derived proposal prior with local score-guided search.
previous_policy_generation_operation.mechanism_boundary: There is a useful executable source-experience transfer signal in this development sample. The unchanged generated policy wins all eight targets and uses 37 queries. However, seven already succeed without history, removing contact-event labels changes no proposal or trajectory, and ordinary GP with the identical source-derived proposal prior also wins all eight in 45 queries. These observations do not establish a distinct new experimental learning mechanism.

previous_native_count_headline_cn: 新部分可观测任务已完成原生短测；完整轨迹含计数未保留的信息，尚不能把基线预测失败归因于缺少新实验。
previous_native_count_report_note_cn: 保留上一轮源程序 8/8、同先验 GP 8/8 的有效结果。本轮补读 MDA 与 APPL 的原始方法，确认假设扩展和结构先验设计已有相关机制。备用 deepseek-v4-pro 返回事件图干预构造建议，但关键学习器和逆程序求解器仍是未实现的占位步骤，未将其认定为新方法。接入原生 NeuronBench（固定源码版本），在钙反跳与钠疲劳两个无噪声机制上各运行 3 次实验和 1 次预测，使用原生 glm-5.3 计数接口。其六个测试协议上的原生预测 MSE 分别为 60.75、200.75；无需真实实验的公开参考动力学模型为 2.4167、109.5833。该基线尚弱，没有形成新方法比较。随后只复用已获得的观测：6 次中 4 次计数与参考模型相同，但完整电压轨迹均不同（RMSE 约 11.17–26.59 mV）。这只是无噪声轨迹差异，不是机制可辨识证明或噪声条件下结果；后续需让构造器与对照共用能处理完整轨迹的机制预测器。本轮共 6 次真实细胞查询、18 次公开参考模型模拟、12 条评分轨迹、9 次成功 API 请求，没有使用 GPU。所有新 API 调用均走已更新备用配置，未重测主接口。

previous_native_count_operation.current: No new construction operation accepted. Event-graph proposal remains underspecified.
previous_native_count_operation.supported_previous: Source-generated geometry-relative action prior, matched by ordinary GP using that prior.
previous_native_count_operation.next_native_carrier: NeuronBench custom multisegment current-clamp experiments and raw-voltage observations, with a shared mechanism learner across acquisition methods.

previous_native_count_carrier.learner_inputs: Only request/response trajectories enter the fitted exponent; hidden-law fields are not supplied to the numerical learner.

assessment.headline_cn: 同样的已有观测交给完整轨迹机制拟合器，两个任务的原生预测 MSE 均为 0；此前的失败未证明需要新实验。
assessment.report_note_cn: 已实现共享的完整电压轨迹预测器：从公开基础动力学与通用额外电流参数化出发，按训练轨迹选择模型，再自由运行预测。只复用上一轮两个机制各 3 次观测，原生六协议计数预测 MSE 从计数 LLM 的 60.75／200.75 降为 0／0；原生特征预测 MSE 分别约 1.61e-28／2.32e-30。钠疲劳选择了公开提供的慢钠动力学，钙反跳由通用单通道参数拟合得到。这是固定模型族内的常规系统辨识，未发现新的实验构造操作，也未复现完整 MDA。两个任务均为无噪声开发实例，部分评分协议与采集菜单重叠；结果不能外推到全部机制、噪声条件或严格未见协议。加速模拟器与原生实现的 8 次公开模型比较通过，最大电压差约 1.51e-11 mV。本轮新增真实采集 0 次、API 调用 0 次，训练用模型模拟 19431 次，预测模拟 12 次，双方一致性模拟各 8 次，隐藏评分轨迹 12 次；未使用 GPU。停止扩展这两个已被基线解决的设置，把预测器保留为后续相同推理能力的比较组件。

ca_rebound.scope: Fixed-family mechanistic fit on existing noiseless voltage; no new experiment constructor or full MDA reproduction.

na_fatigue.scope: Fixed-family mechanistic fit on existing noiseless voltage; no new experiment constructor or full MDA reproduction.

assessment.interpretation: Available observations suffice for native scoring in these two deterministic instances under the public model family. This removes a weak-inference confound; no experiment-construction advantage has been demonstrated.
assessment.inference_boundary: Labels and task identity are stripped before fitting. Source observations and learner hashes match frozen plans. Counts are scored against previously obtained targets; native hidden feature trajectories are generated only after the fitted model is saved. The analyst has inspected benchmark code; the learner does not access hidden world registry values.
assessment.model_family_boundary: Public plain/slow-Na families plus one generic extra channel, eight sign/power/inactivation structures; not open-ended dynamics discovery. Sodium success selects an already supplied kinetic law.
assessment.evaluation_boundary: Two noiseless development instances with native six-protocol scoring, some protocol overlap with the acquisition menu; no robustness, fully unseen-protocol, all-world, or full-MDA claim.
assessment.next_requirement: Do not scale the two solved noiseless development instances or attribute the old count-only failure to missing experiments. Specify and implement a distinct experiment-learning update with source and target roles, then test whether it lowers total acquisition cost with this same full-trace forecaster and equal native control access. A fixed conditioning template, choosing a supplied model family, unspecified inverse program solver, or generic model-metamer construction is not an established new contribution. Keep MDA-style joint model/experiment design and same-prior continuous design as relevant comparators. Novelty and multiple core-task evidence remain required before GPU scale-up.
